summary: Neverkin is a self-hosted application designed for collaborative writing, worldbuilding, and structuring tabletop roleplaying game sessions. It provides a centralised workspace to organise interconnected notes, lore, and narrative documents. The project is built using Node.js and distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for tabletop game masters and collaborative fiction writers who want a dedicated, locally hosted tool to manage complex fictional universes.
watchOut: With a small repository star count and modest maintenance activity, you may encounter edge cases, limited community documentation, or slower bug fixes compared to mainstream note-taking platforms.
deployNotes: Since it is packaged as a Docker container running on Node.js, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
